title: 1.6: Honor pause and exclusions in the MutationObserver
body:
<!-- gitissue:normalized v1 -->

## Type

bug (high confidence)

## Description

Extract `shouldRecord()` and use it from `runPixelDetection` and `observeDynamicPixels`. Add `"storage"` to `manifest.json` `permissions` so pause/exclusions actually persist.

**Current behavior:**
Extract `shouldRecord()` and use it from `runPixelDetection` and `observeDynamicPixels`. Add `"storage"` to `manifest.json` `permissions` so pause/exclusions actually persist.

**Expected behavior:**
The acceptance criteria in this issue hold.
